score_contract.score_semantics: masked-language-model logits/embeddings; no official raw SNV VEP contract verified

provenance.notes: Official checkpoint and model card were audited and the pinned checkpoint passed both the Phase 5 synthetic plumbing smoke and a Phase6A tiny real-GRCh38 embedding-throughput smoke. The published model is a 500M-parameter masked language model with a 2048-token maximum and CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 terms. Phase6A used four SHA-256-selected locked-cohort variants, 8192-bp reference/alternate forward and reverse views, mean-token pooling, finite [16, 1024] pooled outputs, and no feature-cache write; the best warm throughput was 11.7441 variants/s at variant batch size 1 over four variants. No official allele-effect scoring routine or GRCh38 raw-score parity was verified; masked logits are not relabeled as a pseudo-likelihood. This remains SUBSET_ONLY for embeddings/logits, not included in the raw-score benchmark. Evidence: artifacts/model_audit/phase5_real_smokes_20260921.json and artifacts/phase6a/phase6a_representation_throughput_20260921.json.
